request.style: English, male solo voice with full choir, organ, harp, flute, strings, timpani, majestic, reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The heavens are yours, and yours the earth
You founded the world and all that fills it
North and south you created by your word
Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name

[Verse]
Yours is an arm of power and might
Your hand is strong, your right hand lifted high
Righteousness and justice hold your throne
Love and faithfulness go before you

[Chorus]
Blessed are the people who know the festal shout
Who walk, LORD, in the light of your face
They rejoice in your name all day long
In your righteousness they are lifted up

[Verse]
For you are the glory of their strength
By your favor you raise our horn high
Our shield belongs to the LORD alone
Our king to the Holy One of Israel

[Chorus]
Blessed are the people who know the festal shout
Who walk, LORD, in the light of your face
They rejoice in your name all day long
In your righteousness they are lifted up

[Bridge]
Love and faithfulness walk ahead of us
Light upon our path, day and night
We lift our voices in holy praise
To the Holy One of Israel

[Chorus]
Blessed are the people who know the festal shout
Who walk, LORD, in the light of your face
They rejoice in your name all day long
In your righteousness they are lifted up

[Outro]
Walk in your light, O Lord
Walk in your light
